source.title: 2026 Licensed & Bonded Sewage Pumpers/Haulers
source.document_date_note: Page title 2026 Licensed & Bonded Sewage Pumpers/Haulers; pill Revised: 08/12/26; caption Revised August 12, 2026. Official file is HTML (HTTP 200 text/html). A static placeholder prints 35 licensed & bonded pumpers/haulers; the page script sets that count to DATA.length. The DATA array and the rendered page name 36 firms (name, city, phone). No street, state, ZIP, operator, or local registration number. No per-firm ODH bond number.
source.limitations: Transcribed from the Fairfield County Health Department HTML page 2026 Licensed & Bonded Sewage Pumpers/Haulers (pill Revised: 08/12/26; caption Revised August 12, 2026), linked as Sewage haulers & pumpers from Sewage Treatment Systems. The static placeholder count is 35; the page script replaces it with DATA.length, and both the DATA array and a headless print of the rendered page show 36 named firms. All 36 rows are listed in source order (not re-sorted). Spellings kept as printed, including Buds (no apostrophe), Feecorp Corporation, Mt Gilead, Tidy Tims Inc, Sickels Sanitation, LLC, Affordable Portables after All-Star Septic, and The Waterworks after United Rentals (Reliable Onsite Services). City only (no street, state, or ZIP). Operator unknown. Local REG unknown. The page title says the roster is licensed and bonded, but no per-firm bond number is printed, so ODH bond is unknown. Separate installer and service-provider pages on the parent were not merged. Hauler registration is not an inspection credential. Not an endorsement.
